h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Siliguri

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Siliguri

c: Siliguri is the gateway to Darjeeling, Sikkim and the northeast, and it has grown fast as a trading town with new residential complexes on every side. FunPlay Systems works as an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Siliguri for those complexes, and for schools, colleges, army and government campuses and municipal parks. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,780 km away, and sent by road.

A builder adding an amenity often wants an open gym that looks finished on handover day and keeps working for years after. We help by suggesting a compact set, sending a layout drawing with the clear space marked and installing through our team or a dealer in eastern India. Every Fun Fitness station has its own base, so the residents' committee can add more machines later.

richText.heading: Open gym planning for a residential complex

items.q: What outdoor gym setup suits a new housing complex?
items.a: A multi gym frame or four to six single stations grouped near the walking path works well. We plan it around your lawn and play area on one layout drawing.

items.q: Can the builder hand over the gym and the residents add to it later?
items.a: Yes. Each station stands alone, so the residents' committee can add machines later. We keep the layout on record to help plan the additions.

items.q: Do you deliver to north Bengal?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from our Vasai factory to any part of India, and installation is by our team or a dealer in the eastern region.
